tagline: Cream paper with ink outlines on everything: tomato, butter, mint, periwinkle and pink stickers and slabs, hard offset shadows, tilted cards and chunky Gabarito.

palette.description: cream canvas, ink outlines, tomato as the one accent and four flat sticker fills; text on any fill is always ink

typography.style: weight 900 titles with a DM Mono label face

best_for: Consumer-facing decks that should feel like stickers on a laptop. Every filled shape carries a 4 px ink outline and a hard shadow.
avoid_for: Sober, regulated or data-dense contexts; the chunky outlines and tilted cards look informal.
name: Pommi Sticker
